summary: The shell has a clean centered circular-octagonal silhouette, restrained dark-iron and antique-bronze rings, and a large unobstructed transparent center. It contains no baked-in media, glyph, text, digit, identity, branding, official logo, class or specialization mark, recognizable WoW object, green fringe, blur, or perspective error.

findings.detail: The face-on shell is centered, balanced, fully contained, and separated from the canvas edges by transparent padding.
Muted bronze rims, dark forged-iron bands, and restrained cardinal tabs match the summary medallion's material hierarchy without copying its semantic center.
The large center aperture is visually empty and has measured alpha maximum 0 across the recorded central validation crop at both densities.
The outside background is transparent with zero-alpha corners and edges and no measured visible green pixels.
No embedded glyph, media, text, digits, identity, character, official logo, class or specialization mark, or recognizable WoW object is present.
The main outer silhouette, inner aperture, and major metal steps remain distinct at the intended reduced size.

runtimeReviewRequirements: Render inside the 68x68 CSS optical box without non-uniform scaling or additional cropping.
Keep trusted specialization media or the neutral fallback in a separate centered layer fully inside the transparent aperture.
Confirm media contrast, inset clearance, and card alignment in the actual BuildIntelCard composition before promotion.
